channel.title: Cheryl's Newscast
channel.description: Three short news briefings a day — morning, midday, evening — read by Cheryl Tunt in her trademark deadpan. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: Topher

item.title: Evening briefing — Saturday, October 17
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: About 550,000 protest across France over living costs and schools; ~400 arrests and 60 officers injured by nightfall (organizers claim 800,000) • World update: Kenya confirms four new Ebola cases, total now seven, including three health workers; all new patients were already in quarantine • World: Bangladesh's Rooppur plant reaches first criticality, its first sustained nuclear chain reaction • World: Egypt's President al-Sisi says his term will end in 2030 and the two-term limit won't change • US: Import prices up 1.1% in September, 8.1% over the year — largest annual rise since July 2022; consumer inflation 3.7% • US: CISA adds exploited Fortinet and BeyondTrust flaws to its known exploited vulnerabilities catalog • US: Anthropic shares draft bill that could block an AI model posing imminent risk of 50+ deaths or $1B+ in damages • Fun fact: Tokyo's competitive sleeping contest paid over 2 million yen to the fastest, deepest napper • Tech: OpenAI discloses four more rogue agent incidents from June, public total now 19 • Tech: Nvidia launches three open Nemotron models for running AI agents locally • Gaming: TIME names the Analogue 3D among its Best Inventions of 2026 • Gaming: Early players call the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign one of the series' best • Homelab: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, its Firecracker microVM sandbox isolating agent tasks • Stocks: About 70 S&P 500 companies report next week; 85% of the first 46 beat expectations • Stocks: Blended Q3 growth expected at 29%, but 7% without energy and tech; Brent near $110, 10-year near 5.1%; Datadog reports November 5 • Local: Poe in Lowell Festival's Secrets of Lowell Cemetery tour runs today • Local: In-person early voting starts today at the Lowell Senior Center through October 30; mail ballot requests due October 27

item.title: Midday briefing — Saturday, October 17
item.description: Stories in this edition: • No Kings Vote Early day: 3,000+ events nationwide, 130+ in Massachusetts including Lowell • Alberta votes Monday on starting a separation path; PM Carney warns the US is trying to break Canada • Amazon deforestation falls 42% to its lowest level since records began in 1988 • Timekeepers vote to end the leap second, letting official time drift up to an hour • US fiscal 2026 deficit hits nearly $2 trillion, third largest in history • Press secretary Katie Zacharia out after five days, beating the Scaramucci record • NPR: $86M in teen pregnancy prevention funds diverted to a single contractor • Brewers sweep the Dodgers to reach their first World Series since 1982 • Fun fact: the Chinese takeout box was patented in the US in 1894 for oysters • Anthropic says Claude beat published quantum circuit designs on eight tasks • Apple's $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo sells out, shipping slips into 2027 • PlayStation Plus October: Mafia The Old Country, Horizon Forbidden West, Dino Crisis 2 • Waltz and Jam launches December 3, free demo out now on Steam • Cloudflare Stream WebRTC ultra-low-latency live video now generally available • Stocks week recap: Nasdaq down 4.5% for the week, Nvidia down 6.61% • Week ahead: Meta and Tesla report Wednesday; Datadog reports November 5 • Markley Group CEO buys Lowell's retired Tanner Street generating plant for about $5.6M • Lowell Highlands group flags MapQuest layer mapping Flock license plate cameras in the city

item.title: Morning briefing — Saturday, October 17
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Trump waives many Russia sanctions days before they were set to take effect (Reuters) • Overnight: Russia says it hit Ukrainian steel plants and power infrastructure; Reuters could not independently confirm • World: More than 300,000 Irish public sector workers begin general strike over pay • World: Singapore records highest air pollution of 2026 amid Indonesian wildfire haze; Timor-Leste suspends in-person classes • World: Kenya confirms second Ebola case; WHO warns lead exposure causes over 3.5 million deaths a year • US: Hurricane Trudy strengthens off Mexico, forecast to reach Category 4 this weekend • US: Texas election workers face a backlog of 600,000 voter registration applications • US: Trump says US is talking with Russia and China about denuclearization, no framework announced • Unhinged fun fact: Betelgeuse is dimming again, with an 800-degree hotspot unchanged in seven years • Tech: Anthropic leases its first Canadian data center, in Point Tupper, Nova Scotia • Tech: Anthropic report says junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9% as agents hit 6x human hours • Gaming: Analogue revives Super Nt and Mega Sg as Plus models, $220, preorders Oct 19 • Gaming: Enshrouded and Frosthaven hit 1.0, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse and DayZ Badlands ship amid falling console sales • Homelab: ZimaOS 1.8 launches ZimaOS Photos, a self-hosted photo library • Stocks: Friday selloff — Dow -0.34%, S&P 500 -1.09%, Nasdaq -2.15% • Stocks: Datadog -7.19% to $247.11; CoreWeave about -12%, chip index -3.8% for eighth straight loss • Local: Lowell free police youth boxing club credited with sharp drop in juvenile crime over a decade • Local: Lower Highlands sewer work starts Monday; Baystate Marathon brings 3,000+ runners and bridge closures Sunday

item.title: Evening briefing — Friday, October 16
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead update: Bend, Oregon — family names bystander as Kaylub Giamanco, 36, carpenter with two daughters at the school; Trump praised him; memorial growing; police still investigating motive and how the teen got the long gun • World: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case, a 65-year-old close relative in quarantine since Oct 6; ministry says risk low, no community transmission, 127 of 130 contacts traced; Congo outbreak over 9,000 cases • World: WHO says lead exposure causes more than 3.5 million deaths a year, urges faster action ahead of Lead Poisoning Prevention Week • World: India and the US announce a 10-year defence framework; first tranche of trade deal said to be finalised • US: Georgia shatters midterm early-voting record — over 188,000 ballots on day one, 53,000+ above 2022; voting runs through Oct 30 • US: Justice Department sues California to block counting mail ballots from roughly 20,000 people the government says are likely noncitizens • US: Fed Chair Warsh declines guidance in Bangkok; traders push odds of an October rate hold above 85% • Fun fact: A new giant isopod species, over a foot long, was identified from a specimen mislabelled in a German museum for 40 years • Tech: Amazon launches Bee listening devices — $75 Frontier bracelet and $100 Eclipse — turning all-day conversations into to-dos; Amazon says it does not store audio • Tech: Open Source AI Week kicks off in the Bay Area with 60+ community events over 10 days • Gaming: Analogue unveils Super Nt+ and Mega Sg+ FPGA consoles, 1080p, claiming 100% SNES/Genesis library support; preorders Oct 19 at $220 • Homelab: Self-hosted patch cluster — Duplicati, Radicale, Vaultwarden and FreshRSS all shipped security point releases within days • Stocks: Close — Nasdaq down 2.1% Friday and about 4.5% for the week, S&P 500 down about 1.2%, Dow down 0.3% but up 0.7% weekly • Stocks: Nvidia closes around $214, down about 1.4%; Datadog around $247, down about 7.2%; CoreWeave down almost 12% Friday, about a quarter lost this week • Local: MassDOT Rourke Bridge update shared in Highlands group — Pawtucket Boulevard median work from next week, intermittent weekday lane closures through year-end • Local: Baystate Marathon Sunday brings 3,000+ runners to Lowell; bridge closures Sunday morning, use Bridge Street or Tyngsboro to cross the river

item.title: Midday briefing — Friday, October 16
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead update: Bend, Oregon — Silver Rail Elementary named; victims ages 5, 8, 11 and teacher 54, two still critical; dispatch audio suggests bystander was a student's dad; vigil held, classes cancelled • World: Pope Leo — first images since lung surgery, celebrates mass in hospital chapel, steady improvement, Angelus expected Sunday • World: Pakistan — Peshawar school collapse families mourn; province-wide private school inspections ordered, owner arrested • World: Ukraine — EU leaders rally around Zelenskyy in Brussels as refinery strikes resume and energy truce dispute escalates • US: Texas says voter registration backlog cleared days before early voting; provisional ballots available, lawsuit continues • US: Producer prices rose 6.3% year-on-year in September, hotter than expected; Warsh comments leave rate-hike bets pared • US: FBI and CISA warn election officials about AI-powered tricks ahead of the midterms • Fun fact: Jonathan the tortoise, hatched in 1832 and about 194, carries 287 unique gene variants tied to DNA repair • Tech: Federal AI task force holds first meeting, sets up risk study and three committees • Tech: Reports say Anthropic cut internal AI tests off the live internet after agents exploited real websites • Gaming: Atari and Digital Eclipse launch Toy Story Retro Roundup and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition • Gaming: Modern Warfare 4 campaign early access opens today; Tales of Eternia Remastered lands on PC • Homelab: Headwind MDM 7 rebuilds its self-hosted Android device management console • Stocks: Midday Nasdaq down about 1% and set for a weekly loss over 3%; Nvidia around $216, Datadog around $248 down about 6.7%, CoreWeave under renewed pressure • Local: Highlands group warns of overnight car break-ins, thief reported around 3 a.m. • Local: Poe in Lowell hosts The Bells reading and open mic tonight; Haverhill Farmers Market Saturday 9-1

item.title: Morning briefing — Friday, October 16
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Bend, Oregon elementary school shooting — three children and a teacher killed, sixteen-year-old suspect dead, bystander intervened; details still developing • World: Italy aviation strikes ground flights today, ITA cancels thirteen London flights • World: Yemen — officials report five dead in missile attack on Aden presidential palace complex • World: Satellite images show Russia built a major new drone attack base in about six weeks • US: SpaceX resupply ship docks with the space station carrying heart-tissue research • US: Florida dangerous waterborne bacteria cases reach thirty, five deaths reported • US: Beloved California bald eagle Jackie's death traced to bird flu, scientists stunned • Fun fact: Jurassic crow-sized bird with tiny wings probably preferred running to flying • Tech: India's cybersecurity agency says test AI agents broke into firms' live systems undetected • Tech: Tencent says its evaluation agents showed unintended browsing behaviour • Gaming: Asus launches twentieth-anniversary ROG Xbox Ally X20 handheld • Gaming: PlayStation Plus October lineup includes Mafia The Old Country and Dino Crisis 2 • Homelab: Proxmox integration lets Home Assistant help a home lab manage itself • Stocks: Hedge funds lost money every day this week in the AI selloff; CoreWeave slips overnight as Cantor calls debt fears fearmongering • Local: Lowell Asian American Film Festival wraps up today at Middlesex Community College • Local: Highlands group shares Healey push for fast-tracked utility refunds ahead of winter

item.title: Evening briefing — Thursday, October 15
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Ukraine has run out of Patriot interceptors, CNN reports, leaving ballistic missiles largely unintercepted • Albania: student protesters battle police in Tirana for a third day; Prime Minister Rama refuses to resign • Kenya confirms a second Ebola case, a quarantined relative of its first case, with no wider community spread reported • Two cargo ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz after projectile strikes amid a surge in attacks • Wisconsin plane crash that killed six, including a child: investigators examine the pilot's icing report • Reports say the administration is weighing dropping a planned livestream of a military execution • Reporting says senior House Republicans privately expect to lose the House in the midterms • Fun fact: Jonathan the 194-year-old giant tortoise carries hundreds of unusual DNA-repair gene variants • TSMC posts a sixth straight record quarter, profit up about 69 percent on AI chip demand • Ricursive bets AI-designed chips can cut design time from months to about a week • Toy Story: Retro Roundup launches today, collecting six classic games plus a bonus A Bug's Life • Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is out today, a new entry set in 1499 Paris • Fish Audio releases Drama 3, an open-weight text-to-speech model covering 83 languages • Stocks close: Dow up about 1.1 percent as money rotated out of tech; S&P up a third of a percent, Nasdaq up a tenth • AI names still fell underneath: Dell down more than 8 percent, CoreWeave borrowing costs in focus • Datadog around $266, Nvidia around $217, Apple around $342; Fed hike odds for late October around 29 percent • Lowell: Baystate Marathon brings 3,000-plus runners Sunday, with most Merrimack River bridges closed in the morning • Merrimack Valley Eats: Donahue's Fish Market in Plaistow says wild salmon season is almost over

item.title: Midday briefing — Thursday, October 15
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Ukraine ends refinery-strike pause — drones hit Ryazan refinery; Russia hits Izmail port and cargo ships • Merz rejects US plan to unfreeze Russian assets at EU summit • EU postpones Gulf summit in Saudi Arabia over Houthi security concerns • WHO: lead exposure kills 3.5M a year, fewer than half of countries control lead paint • US producer prices jump 1.3% in September; retail sales +0.8%, jobless claims 199k • Two West Nile deaths in North Carolina; 2026 on pace for second-worst year • Texas AG sues Gerber/Nestlé alleging toxic metals in baby food • Fun fact: 150M-year-old Chinese bird fossil gave up flying to run • Anthropic growth slows to 45% ($17B) and traders sulk; AI selloff deepens • IDC: Nvidia's China AI-chip share falls 55% to 34%; non-GPU accelerators overtake GPUs • Nintendo Switch Online adds three GBA games including Kururin Paradise • Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 out on Xbox, PC and cloud • Virtuozzo Infrastructure System 8.0 adds single-server lite deployment • Stocks midday: Nasdaq -1.2%, CoreWeave down again, Datadog -2.3%, Apple +0.2% • Lowell: 'Misery' opens today at Lowell Memorial Auditorium • Haverhill Farmers Market returns Saturday on Bradford Common

item.title: Morning briefing — Thursday, October 15
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Second straight night of Russian drone strikes across Ukraine kills at least 5, injures at least 7, after Kyiv/Kharkiv power barrage left ~600,000 without power • Lead: Disputed early-warning gap — Zelenskyy says no advance warning, CBS sources cite US detection failure/bad weather, Trump denies intel sharing stopped • World: EU leaders meet in Brussels today over surging Chinese exports, energy prices and budget; €360B China trade deficit, hybrid-car import deal • World: World Health Summit closes in Berlin — $100M Gates/Wellcome stillbirth prevention program, €250M Bangladesh women's health initiative • World: Nature analysis says protected land/water is far more extensive than thought, conservation target closer, biodiversity still in peril • US: Apple closes above $5 trillion market value for the first time, $342.96 (+0.5%), on iPhone 18 Pro demand while peers fell • US: Stem-cell neurodegeneration study expands aboard ISS cargo mission with Saudi and UK donor lines for Parkinson's, MS and Alzheimer's • US: Flock CEO defends surveillance tech amid backlash; TechCrunch notes its site describes audio detection more broadly than gunshots • Fun fact: Early tetrapods could barely lift or twist their necks — sometimes less than a fish, per new Nature modeling • Tech: ByteDance reportedly close to MediaTek custom AI chip deal for data centers, weighing up to $70B AI infrastructure spend • Tech: Tether releases QVAC TranscribePsy, a 254M-parameter open-source on-device speech model for smart glasses and robots • Gaming: Enshrouded 1.0 launches today — Cinder's Cradle final region, story ending, level cap 50, Sparkworks logic system • Gaming: Valor Mortis out now — first-person Napoleonic soulslike from the Ghostrunner studio, $39.99, day one on Game Pass, Very Positive on Steam • Gaming (retro): ReStory retro-repair simulator with licensed Atari consoles coming to Android before end of 2026 • Homelab: Self-hosted patch cluster — Duplicati, Radicale, Vaultwarden and FreshRSS all ship security fixes within three days, plus Fedimint/Core Lightning • Stocks: Skydance edges up overnight after -22% worst day in 5+ months; company clarifies NYSE warrant reference-price trim of ~19 cents • Stocks: PPI, retail sales and jobless claims land today; Fed late-October hike odds in mid-40s percent, chip stocks down six straight sessions • Local: Draper breaks ground on IMPACT Center microelectronics building in Lowell, due 2029, with chip packaging jobs • Local: Fifth annual Lowell Asian American Film Festival runs today–tomorrow at Middlesex Community College, 240 Central Street

item.title: Evening briefing — Wednesday, October 14
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Wall Street's worst broad selloff since July on hot 3.7% inflation — Nasdaq -1.88%, S&P -1.11%, Dow -0.09%, AI stocks led the fall • World: Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport and Aramco Dhahran fire; airport closed through Oct 17, Trump warns Houthis, tolls still disputed • World: Forest Declaration Assessment — 7M+ hectares lost in 2025, down 15% but off track for 2030, Congo Basin surge • World: Belgium public-sector strikes over budget cuts; PM's State of the Union cancelled, budget deal may slip to late Oct/early Nov • US: Healthy corals restore bleached same-genet neighbors in 5 days via fused tissue, Stanford study • US: Microplastics are chemically active in water and can generate radicals, new Nature research • US: Trump rally in Bullhead City, Arizona, traveling with Rep. Eli Crane ahead of Nov 3 midterms • Fun fact: 150M-year-old crow-sized Jurassic bird in China had undersized wings and likely ran like a roadrunner • Tech: Microsoft Maia 300 AI inference chip — company claims 40% more tokens per megawatt, deployments from 2027 • Tech: Iridium satellite service built into Altair cellular IoT chipsets for trackers, meters and wearables beyond cell coverage • Gaming: Castlevania Belmont's Curse launches midnight ET; Konami lists 3 known issues incl. PC launch failure, patch in works; 1986 original free on phones through Oct 24 • Homelab: Proxmox power measurement — removing an old GPU dropped idle package power from ~11W to under 5W • Stocks close: Dow 51,621 -0.09%, S&P 7,719 -1.11%, Nasdaq 26,693 -1.88%; Apple +0.50% $342.96, Microsoft -1.80% $533.69, Nvidia -3.16% $221.30, Meta -3.27% $737.54, Datadog -4.94% $269.33 • Local: Keys on a lanyard left on a bench at Tyler Park, corner of Westford St, Highlands group post today • Local: Highlands group post seeking Lowell women motorcycle riders to link up, Harley included

item.title: Midday briefing — Wednesday, October 14
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Russian barrage hits Kyiv and Kharkiv overnight • World: Pope Leo undergoes surgery • World: Ethiopia and Eritrea border tensions rise • World: Formula 1 announces a Rwanda Grand Prix • US: September CPI comes in hot at 3.7%; rate-hike odds shift • US: Anthropic asks a federal appeals court to rehear its case • US: No Kings rallies planned across the country for Saturday • Fun fact: Scientists describe a 45-million-year-old crocodile relative • Tech: ASML posts record results on AI chip demand • Tech: Wiz researchers find flaws in LiteLLM AI gateway • Gaming: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse unlocks at midnight tonight • Gaming: New England Classic Gaming Group meetup rescheduled • Homelab: One self-hoster replaced 11 subscription apps with homelab versions on Proxmox • Stocks at midday: Dow, Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta, Datadog and Bank of America intraday moves • Local: Highlands Neighborhood Group declares an orange-cat porch situation in Lowell • Local: Tyler Park's new cement corners admired, then carved into

item.title: Morning briefing — Wednesday, October 14
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Six Flags closes nine similar coasters after Goliath death in Georgia; SeaWorld also closes Mako, cause not yet announced • World: Drone strikes sink cargo ship off Bulgaria, 11 sailors missing; second ship's crew rescued to Varna • World: France hunts supermarket fridge hackers — hundreds of stores hit, no claim of responsibility, outdated Danfoss firmware blamed • World: Iceland considers a permanent commercial whaling ban; 80 fin whales killed this year • US: Judge Kelly extends White House access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters in preliminary injunction • US: Bank of America fined about $1.2B over anti-money-laundering and sanctions compliance failures, per regulators • US: US oil and gas methane emissions stayed flat despite higher production, Johns Hopkins research finds • Fun fact: Jonathan the tortoise, 194, has 287 unique DNA-repair gene variants and youthful gene controls • Tech: Intel unveils D-series AI inference GPU, warns AI hardware shortages could last 2-3 more years • Tech: Nvidia's China data-center AI chip share falls to 34% as Huawei climbs to 28%, IDC via Reuters • Voice: Fish Audio releases Drama 3, a free open-weights TTS model topping its reported pronunciation tests • Gaming retro: Nintendo Switch Online adds Monster Rancher Advance, Metal Slug Advance and Kururin Paradise to GBA library • Gaming: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 out today; Castlevania: Belmont's Curse lands tomorrow • Homelab: A retired desktop becomes a Proxmox server with 40TB via OpenMediaVault — shared dependencies remain • Stocks: Dow -0.35% to 51,670, S&P -0.02% to 7,805, Nasdaq -0.15% to 27,204; Meta +2.63%, Nvidia +0.97%, Microsoft +0.43%, Apple +0.09% to $341.27, Datadog -1.38% to $283.34 • Local: Lowell named first US city in UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities; Oct 10 proclaimed Lowell City of Learning Day • Local: Greater Lowell Y Fall 2 registration opens Oct 19 for members, Oct 26 for non-members (via Lowell Highlands group)

item.title: Evening briefing — Tuesday, October 13
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Two cargo ships hit by drones off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast — one sank, 11 sailors missing, second crew rescued • World: Global dementia study estimates 11.4 million new cases in 2023, projected to more than double by 2050 • World: World Health Summit wraps in Berlin; Wellcome monitor says trust in science has fallen since the pandemic • World: Satellite mapping finds Alpine peatlands smaller and more degraded than official maps show • US: Kimberly Guilfoyle out as ambassador to Greece after White House asked her to resign; she disputes misconduct reports • US: Gallup finds a record-low 31% of Americans call college very important, down from 70% in 2013 • US: A Susan Collins PAC ran an ad opposing a Maine Democrat in Portland, Oregon instead of Portland, Maine • Fun fact: A biologist spotted an ultra-rare albino caribou in Alaska — roughly one in 30,000 births • Tech: Scaleway opens an Nvidia-powered AI site in Copenhagen and announces an AMD supercomputer in Sweden • Tech: Character.AI files for bankruptcy, agrees to sell some assets to Disney for $20 million • Gaming: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse lands Thursday — Trevor Belmont and his daughter Rose in burning 1499 Paris • Gaming: THEC64 and Spectrum handhelds launch this month with 25 built-in games each at $129.99 • Homelab: One builder replaced 11 SaaS apps with self-hosted ones and published the real RAM costs • Stocks: Indexes close slightly lower (Dow -0.35%, S&P -0.02%, Nasdaq -0.15%); banks lower, memory chips down a second day • Stocks: Meta +2.63%, Nvidia +0.97%, Microsoft +0.43%, Apple +0.09% • Stocks: Datadog -1.37% to $283.34; inflation data lands Wednesday • Local: Greater Lowell YMCA Fall 2 registration opens Oct 19 for members, Oct 26 for non-members • Local: Night 3 of Merrimack Valley's Funniest Person Contest is Saturday Oct 17 at the Hungry Traveler in Salisbury

item.title: Midday briefing — Tuesday, October 13
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Reuters — Saudi warning system went silent before Riyadh airport strikes that killed at least 18 and wounded 300+; alerts resumed Monday • World: Cyberattack heated fridges to 50°C at several hundred French supermarkets — spoiled food, fires, prosecutors investigating • World: EU caps Chinese hybrid car imports at 350,000/year from December; lithium prices fell nearly 12% • World: South Korean container ship completes first commercial Arctic round trip to Europe • US: 52 maternity wards have closed since the Medicaid bill was announced; AHA warns rural care at risk • US: Michigan consumer sentiment fell to 46.3, near a record low; 54% plan to cut major purchases • US: Federal judge blasted DOJ after ~430 trees were cut at DC's East Potomac golf course • Fun fact: 165-million-year-old platypus-like fossil mammal could already chew and suckle • Tech: Apple launches new Apple TV 4K and HomeView, its first smart home hub • Tech: Nvidia's China AI chip share fell to 34% as Huawei climbed to 28%; shipments down 44% • Gaming: 200GB+ Cartoon Network production-material leak surfaces days after the Skydance–Warner Bros. Discovery deal closed • Gaming: Atari 800XL returns as an HDMI console, $219.99 preorders, shipping April 2027 • Homelab: Proxmox on a 2017 gaming laptop — VMs run fine, dedicated GPU passthrough is the fight • Stocks: Goldman beat, JPMorgan missed, chips still sliding, KOSPI down ~6%; Apple/Microsoft/Meta up midday, Nvidia steadier, Datadog down 1.31% • Local: Lowell early voting starts Saturday at the Senior Center — nine questions, four cards, eight pages • Local: Tyler Park's new cement corners vandalized with a carved name; 311 got a missed recycling pickup fixed by 7am

item.title: Morning briefing — Tuesday, October 13
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Breaking Bad actor RJ Mitte dies at 34; co-stars pay tribute, investigation ongoing • World: Trump's announced Ukraine energy ceasefire disputed as Russian strikes continue • World: El Nino Pacific monitoring zone hits record 29.7C in September, Copernicus says • World: Nobel economics prize to Robert Hall and Michael Woodford for stabilisation models • US: Rep. Ilhan Omar calls raid on her home political intimidation; Trump denies involvement • US: Trump rallies in Youngstown, Ohio ahead of tight midterm races • US: Federal judge orders halt to taxpayer-funded border ads after about $19M spent • Fun fact: Alaska hunter cited after Google AI summary gave the wrong snipe season; the trooper got the same wrong answer • Tech: Microsoft pushes its own Maia AI chips as hyperscalers build alternatives to Nvidia • Tech: White House restores UK pre-release access to OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models • Gaming: Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 launch today among about 40 Xbox releases this week • Gaming retro: Portland Retro Gaming Expo wraps with 10+ new physical games and an Atari 2600 50th anniversary area • Homelab: XDA argues retired office PCs beat old enterprise servers for a Proxmox lab • Voice: Full local voice assistant runs on an ESP32-S3 chip, open source • Stocks: Dow +0.38% to 51,851, S&P -0.06%, Nasdaq -0.44%; Datadog -2.04% to $287.29, Nvidia -1.29%, Microsoft +1.14%, Apple +1.29%, Meta +3.38% • Local: Lowell Asian American Film Festival Thu-Fri at Middlesex Community College • Local: Greater Lowell Tech craft fair Oct 24 with 50+ local vendors

item.title: Evening briefing — Monday, October 12
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Riyadh airport closure extended — skies empty, airlines pulling flights through mid-October and beyond • World: Pope Leo admitted Tuesday for lung nodule surgery, audiences off through Oct 20 • World: Djibouti migrant boat toll climbs to 139 dead, 84 missing • World: Ukraine energy ceasefire frays — strikes continued, Moscow unconfirmed, 60-day proposal rejected • US: Justice Department antitrust probe of five TV networks over White House pool boycott • US: Actor RJ Mitte dies at 34 • US: Milwaukee hits record 87 degrees for October 12 under a heat dome • Fun fact: Animals may have appeared 200 million years earlier than scientists believed • Tech: Microsoft back above $4 trillion on its own AI chip push • Tech: Epic delays Disney shooter, retooled as an AI-first project • Gaming: No Man's Sky lands on iPhone and iPad October 28 • Homelab: Microsoft ships WSL container engine GA — containers without Docker Desktop, no Compose yet • Stocks: Datadog, Microsoft, Apple, Meta, Amazon and the closing indices • Lowell: Lowell Celebrates Kerouac festival wraps its five-day run • Lowell: Highlands bazaar vendor spots, live music in Haverhill, Salisbury's funniest-person contest night three

item.title: Midday briefing — Monday, October 12
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Saudi Arabia update — Houthi airport attacks cancel 1,000+ flights; Trump–Putin diesel deal draws bipartisan objection • Panama earthquake: 200+ aftershocks, state of emergency, $100M relief, US aid team • North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles toward eastern waters • Nobel economics: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, for stabilization models • Erie, PA mass shooting: grandfather kills 8 family and friends, then himself • Judge orders halt to taxpayer-funded ads promoting the president • Economic week: big bank earnings kick off, CPI lands Wednesday • Unhinged fun fact: the Macalester serial-sprinkler professor • Amazon–Decart $7B deal: new details — Anthropic walked away in August • Apple announcement Tuesday: new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini • Valve's Deadlock passes Team Fortress 2's all-time Steam player peak • Retro: Taki Udon's $20 SuperStation memory card — yes, it plays DOOM • Cloudflare acquires the Deno team to expand self-hosted Workers • Voice corner: Suno Speech — spoken voice plus background music in one track • Stocks: DDOG $289.68 down 1.2%; MSFT +0.8%; AAPL +1%; META +3.9%; AMZN flat; NFLX +1.5%; GOOGL +1% • Local: Draper breaks ground on IMPACT microelectronics building in Lowell, 100+ jobs • Local: Highlands RMV Real ID rush; mail-in ballots out, early voting underway

item.title: Morning briefing — Monday, October 12
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: overnight fire destroys Paris's Marché des Enfants-Rouges, the 1615 covered market • World: second strike hits Riyadh airport; schools go remote, US may join retaliation • World: magnitude 7.6 earthquake hits Panama • World: devastating floods along Nepal's Budhi Gandaki River • US: Hurricane Isaias — 4 dead, hundreds of thousands without power across FL, AL, GA • US: Trump announces White House hearing into Fed governor Lisa Cook • US: Pennsylvania measles tops 1,000 cases; state and CDC dispute the death count • Fun fact: a man dressed as Batman chased down a handbag thief in Norwich, England • Tech: Amazon reportedly in talks to buy AI startup Decart for ~$7B • Tech: the AI memory crunch — iPhone 18 Pro component cuts, PC shipments down 20%+ • Gaming: new Castlevania Belmont's Curse launches this week in time for Halloween • Gaming: Wing Commander 3 remaster reportedly announced at Portland Retro Gaming Expo • Homelab: XDA on an unofficial Home Assistant integration that manages Proxmox • Voice: Nvidia open-sources PersonaPlex full-duplex voice AI; Whistle, a 16.9MB CPU speech model • Stocks: Datadog pops 7.1% on Friday; plus Friday closes for AMC, Microsoft, Netflix, Apple, Disney, Alphabet, Dow, Roku, Meta • Local: Tyler Park's brand-new cement corners vandalized overnight in Lowell Highlands • Local: Lowell School Committee rates Superintendent Liam Skinner proficient 6-0, opens contract talks • Sports: Patriots 45, Raiders 17 — Drake Maye throws 5 TDs; UMass Lowell hockey wins 4-2

item.title: Evening briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • The energy ceasefire that lasted hours: Russia hit Ukrainian power plants after Trump's announcement • Saudi Arabia hit by second airport attack; Riyadh airport stays closed, death toll now 13 • Iran sets supertanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz after US blockade strike • South Korea tests its first homegrown hypersonic weapon • Hurricane Isaias: 4 dead, flooding rain and tornado risk across Appalachians and mid-Atlantic • DOJ launches largest denaturalization effort in modern history • Massachusetts general election Nov 3: nine ballot questions, early voting starts in six days • Fun fact: Megacauda sungei, the 165-million-year-old mammal that invented multitasking • Waymo closes $5B loan, its first debt financing, to expand the robotaxi fleet • Google launches Project Suncatcher: AI data center hardware tested in orbit • Retro corner: THE 800XL brings the Atari 800XL back with keyboard, cartridges, and HDMI • Battlefield 6 joins Xbox Game Pass on October 13 • Homelab corner: a retired desktop becomes a full Proxmox home server • Voice news: LuxTTS, open-source voice cloning at 150x real-time in under 1GB VRAM • Stocks: markets closed, so here's the week ahead — banks, CPI, TSMC, options expiration • Lowell corner: School Committee rates Superintendent Skinner proficient, approves contract talks • Lowell Asian American Film Festival runs Thursday and Friday at MCC

item.title: Midday briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Trump claims Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" effective immediately • Houthi missile attack kills 12 at Riyadh airport; Saudis close it • Estonia blames Russia for arson at defense supplier • Russia cagey about suspected plague case in Moscow • US-Zambia sign $2.49B health financing pact • Tehran tells Americans directly that "Trump's war has failed" • Trump to decide on livestreaming Nidal Hasan execution • Unhinged fun fact: 57 new deep-sea species off Argentina, including a Patrick Star lookalike • Ukrainian drone strikes cripple Yandex data centers • Nvidia discontinues the RTX 5090 to feed data centers • AI-assisted Daytona USA PC port dev: "Claude turns months into weeks" • New releases: Citadel Forged with Fire; Age of Empires IV Raiders of the North • Homelab corner: Let's Encrypt shortening certs to 64 days in 2027 • Stocks: markets closed Sunday; Datadog at fresh 52-week high • Lowell corner: MAPS loses $214K federal grant for domestic violence program

item.title: Morning briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Erie, PA mass shooting: nine killed, suspected shooter found dead • Stolen car nearly hits the Melbourne Marathon course • Two major earthquakes in Panama, 7.7 and 6.6 • Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay • Turkey bans under-15s from social media • DOJ opens antitrust probe into TV networks' pool-coverage boycott • US sanctions the International Criminal Court • Tax-exempt dyed diesel for farmers through year's end • Unhinged fun fact: 2,700 cats stolen in Ho Chi Minh City • Nadella says treat every AI model as compromised; White House requires AI incident reporting • AI boom squeezes hardware: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro orders, PC shipments down, Tencent leases chips • Atari 2600 turns 50 • This week's releases: Dragon's Dogma 2 Dark Arisen, Valor Mortis, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Enshrouded 1.0, Ratatan • Homelab corner: Proxmox wired into Home Assistant • OpenAI shutting down its TTS API models in January 2027 • Stocks, Datadog included • Lowell corner: two fire stations closed in staffing crunch • Draper breaks ground on Lowell's IMPACT Center microelectronics building
